summary: Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi will remain in San Raffaele Hospital in Milan after an assault that left him with facial damage, two broken teeth, a broken nose and cuts to his lips following a political rally. The attacker, 42-year-old Massimo Tartaglia, who eyewitnesses said was carrying a replica of Milan's Duomo Cathedral made of heavy material, is in police custody and has been charged with aggravated assault. Berlusconi will stay in hospital until at least Tuesday and can eat only with difficulty; spokesman Paolo Bonaiuti said they were keeping him at rest, while Northern League leader Umberto Bossi called the incident an "act of terrorism" and a "worrying sign."
